name: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion
summary: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a 19th-century cursed mansion in Istanbul. Armed with only a flashlight, find the hidden talismans, survive the relentless Djinn, and uncover the dark secrets of Molla Celil.
